original.statement: XDS generation behavior was changed so it is aligned whether or not a Sidecar resource is configured; details are in the upgrade notes.

decision.reason: [ev-e4fce3d0047f] says the behavior of XDS generation was "Updated" so it is aligned whether or not a user has a `Sidecar` configured. That is the same configuration with different semantics, so behavior-changed fits. Because XDS generation is about the configuration served to proxies, protocol-behavior is a reasonable family. The kebab-case name "xds-generation-sidecar-alignment" uses the evidence's own key words and is clear without extra words.
